mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) confirms robust economic activity that supports corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods with INDPRO rising.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent unemployment rates above 5.0% consistently suppress consumer spending and business investment, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 650.0 thousand units signal strong construction activity that stimulates consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases.
